records.eligibility_summary: The Moreau Scholarship may be offered to one graduate from each Holy Cross high school. The scholarship seeks to recognize students who have been outstanding representatives of Holy Cross values in the classroom and in the community. To be considered, a completed St. Edward’s admission application and Moreau Scholarship application must be received by December 15, 2026.For more information and to access the Fall 2027 Moreau Scholarship application, click here.International students must also include PSAT, TOEFL, IELTS, PTE, AP Exam, IB Exam, GCE/GCSE, or the Duolingo English Test
